turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first: who decided that, and on what basis?
I don't think this is productive.
"Productive." You asked for this meeting, Hale, and I came. Either you tell me what that zero is based on, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
Then you have ten minutes. The zero comes off, and I want an apology to Owen. If you walk out that door without answering me, I'm going straight upstairs to the principal.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.

I'm writing down that you walked away without telling me what the zero is based on. Your own procedure, 4.2, says you call home before any mark goes in, and nobody called me. I'm not emailing the principal, Hale; I'm walking to that office right now.
